pages.text: An OPERATOR block holds one symbol of an expression.$(br2)Right-click it with an empty hand and click a symbol. It can be an operator, $(1)($(), $(1))$() or the $(1);$() that ends every expression. A new block shows a question mark.
Put a red wool block in the middle and eight NOOP blocks around it. You get eight OPERATOR blocks.
$(1)*$() comes before $(1)+$(), and $(1)($() and $(1))$() group. $(1)=$() only compares; to store a value, use ASSIGN.
